mapper.sql: select r.rule_id, r.shop_code, r.goods_code, g.goodsname as goods_name, r.ware_code, w.warename as ware_name, r.threshold_qty, r.enabled, r.remark, r.create_by, r.create_time, r.update_by, r.update_time from sdsshop.u_m_warning_rule r left join sdsshop.u_m_waregoods g on g.shop_code = r.shop_code and g.goodscode = r.goods_code left join sdsshop.u_m_warehouse w on w.shop_code = r.shop_code and w.warecode = r.ware_code
mapper.insert: insert into sdsshop.u_m_warning_rule (shop_code, goods_code, ware_code, threshold_qty, enabled, remark, create_by, create_time) values (#{shopCode}, #{goodsCode}, #{wareCode}, #{thresholdQty}, #{enabled}, #{remark}, #{createBy}, sysdate())
mapper.update: update sdsshop.u_m_warning_rule set goods_code = #{goodsCode}, ware_code = #{wareCode}, threshold_qty = #{thresholdQty}, enabled = #{enabled}, remark = #{remark}, update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = sysdate() where shop_code = #{shopCode} and rule_id = #{ruleId}
